text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To prepare for Espoir City's overseas campaign,
I introduced her to several skilled veteran Trainers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so she headed to America.
Together with the trainer whose style suited her best—!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
10th place?!!
That's a total blowout!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, we suffered a crushing defeat in America's major race, the BC Classic.
Our journey overseas together ended in utter disaster.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...In the end, Espoir City didn't change her Trainer on her own accord.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Among the candidates to be her Trainer were
veterans with extensive overseas experience
and renowned Trainers invited from abroad.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, perhaps they just didn't get along...
she rejected every single candidate.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Give me a break, will ya?
You're already the best Trainer I could ask for.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Understands what you're saying, is considerate,
and can devise strategies to win.
choice_data_list: Sorry, next time I'll find something that suits you better—
I apologize, next time I will find something that suits you better—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...And what happened after that?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "Suits me"... what?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You're the only Trainer
I'll ever have.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I swallowed the words that almost slipped out.
If she chose me...
then I must fulfill my duties as her Trainer."
choice_data_list: I'll come up with a strategy that suits you better.
I'll come up with a strategy that suits you better.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...That is fine.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Even if my Trainer's a total greenhorn,
it doesn't change the fact that I'm strong as hell.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Catch up to me.
I'll be waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Trust me.
Trust what I've decided.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I consult with Espoir City
about the next race we should aim for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Next time, we will seize victory for sure.
A victory worthy of a powerful Umamusume.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I must not leave her side.
...Because I am Espoir City's
Trainer.
